prompts.board: Use case: game-asset. Asset type: original production-quality dark fantasy collectible card game battlefield BACKGROUND PLATE, no UI. Create an Eruldin: Echoes battle board matching the gothic painterly craftsmanship and warm refuge/cold ruin palette of the supplied environment image (reference only). Wide landscape 16:9 camera near overhead, shallow 3D perspective, symmetric gameplay layout. A broad flat rectangular playing surface of weathered dark jade green slate and worn walnut, beautifully carved restrained bronze borders, occupies central 72% of picture. Leave the entire center smooth quiet low contrast, enough clear space for two rows of five cards each, no card slots engraved. Thin restrained horizontal central seam. Along left and right edges: ruined gothic miniature architecture, roots, candles, amber brazier, old books, moss, a broken stone arch; all framing details must stay outside play area. Opponent top edge cold blue fog; player bottom edge warm amber sanctuary. Two understated circular bronze avatar pedestals in the left border top and bottom, empty centers. Rendered physically believable metal, stone, wood with hand-painted dark fantasy finish, exacting art direction, soft lighting readable game board, no excessive bloom. No characters, no cards, no text, no numbers, no HUD, no brands, no Riot symbols, no copied existing board. Landscape high resolution. Preserve quiet usable negative space; this is a reusable asset not screenshot or promotional scene.
prompts.cardFrames: Use case: game-asset. Asset type: reusable transparent PNG card-frame atlas for original Eruldin dark fantasy card game. Create ONE ATLAS with EXACTLY THREE equal vertical card frames in a single horizontal row, left champion, middle follower, right spell. Each frame has identical 3:4 outer proportions and consistent geometry, generous empty space between frames, fully visible and isolated. Canvas transparent, all outside each frame transparent. Each frame's large upper art window MUST be actual transparent empty cutout, not white, black or checkerboard. Beneath window a blank dark evergreen parchment-like rules box and narrow blank name banner, no text. Blank round bronze cost socket at top left; blank bronze stat sockets bottom left and right for champion/follower, spell one small center medallion instead. Champion left: ornate restrained aged gold with gothic cathedral arches and branching motif, ivory corners, tiny amber gemstone above. Follower center: weathered bronze, dark jade enamel, simpler branches and wrought iron, green small gem. Spell right: cold tarnished silver, thin ivory inlay, organic round-topped window and wispy frozen metal detail, small blue-white gem. Strong readable silhouette, masterfully painted volumetric metal highlights from upper left, engraved patina, craftsmanship like high-end fantasy physical collectibles. Practical thin borders, artwork covers upper 65%, rules panel lower 25%. No illustration, no portrait, no text, no numbers, no logos, no franchise symbols, no decorative spikes leaving bounds. True RGBA transparent exterior and transparent image windows. High resolution clean straight-on flat orthographic view; not photographed on table, not mockup.
